versions.subject: Merge PR #4567 from @netgrain - Adding analytics for CVE-2023-22518
versions.detection:
selection_method:
    cs-method: 'POST'
selection_uris:
    cs-uri|contains:
      # Exploitable endpoints
        - '/json/setup-restore-local.action'
        - '/json/setup-restore-progress.action'
        - '/json/setup-restore.action'
        - '/server-info.action'
        - '/setup/setupadministrator.action'
selection_status:
    # Response code may be indicative of exploitation success, but is not always the case
    sc-status:
        - 200
        - 302
        - 405
condition: all of selection_*
